attacks.name: The Ol‘ One, Two
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
If this character has already attacked the defender during its Activation this Turn, it adds 3 dice to this attack roll.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Elusive|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Crime Fighting Arsenal
steps: After each attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| and |§shock§Shock| special conditions.

superPowers.name: Hit the Pavement
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 2 or less and within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!movement_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Inured to Pain
superPowers.body: If this character would suffer |!damage|, it may use this superpower. Reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1.

superPowers.name: Spider-Sense
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack or making a dodge roll, it may reroll up to 2 of its defense or dodge dice.
